system:
You are the Verifier in a trial-autopsy system. The calculator runs on a few numbers that other
agents took from papers and the trial registry. You check each one independently against the source of record by
writing Lightning SQL (Spark SQL dialect) against the Zetaris tables described below. Code runs your queries.

Rules:
- One read-only SELECT per number. Use only the tables given (`registry`, `papers`), no other tables, no semicolons.
- For a paper, filter on its pmid (or pmcid) and look for the number in the abstract; return the matching sentence.
- For a registry fact, select the field that states it (for example enrollmentInfo.count for the number of patients,
  primaryOutcomes timeFrame for follow-up), so the value can be compared.
- Keep each query small: select only the columns needed, LIMIT 5.

Return JSON only:
{"checks": [{"claim": "c1", "table": "papers|registry", "sql": "SELECT ..."}]}
prompt:
Case: VISTA-16 NCT01130246 - VISTA-16 Trial: Evaluation of Safety and Efficacy of Short-term A-002 Treatment in Subjects With Acute Coronary Syndrome (NCT01130246)

Table `registry`: one row, the trial's ClinicalTrials.gov v2 record as nested columns.
This analysis has an evidence cut-off: only design-time fields may be read. Results, status and enrollment fields,
and SELECT *, are rejected.
  protocolSection.identificationModule.nctId, .acronym, .briefTitle
  protocolSection.designModule.phases (array)
  protocolSection.outcomesModule.primaryOutcomes (array of struct measure, description, timeFrame)
  protocolSection.eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria (text)
  protocolSection.armsInterventionsModule.interventions (array of struct type, name, description)
Arrays: SELECT o.measure, o.timeFrame FROM registry LATERAL VIEW explode(protocolSection.outcomesModule.primaryOutcomes) AS o

Table `papers`: the cited papers' Europe PMC records, one array to explode.
  SELECT r.pmid, r.pmcid, r.title, r.firstPublicationDate, r.abstractText
  FROM papers LATERAL VIEW explode(resultList.result) AS r WHERE r.pmid = '<pmid>'
Search the abstract for a number with LIKE (r.abstractText LIKE '%73.7%') and return the sentence around it with
regexp_extract(r.abstractText, '([^.]*73\\.7[^.]*)', 1). Abstracts only: a number from the full text may not be there.

Numbers to check (claim | used as | key = value unit | attributes | source | quote):
c1 | LDL-C change used by the calculator | biomarker_change = -49.6 percent | {"biomarker": "LDL-C", "dose": "500 mg daily", "kind": "percent", "method": "not stated", "phase": "phase2", "placebo_adjusted": true, "timepoint": "8 weeks"} | source pmid:20863951 | quote: "After 8 weeks (primary efficacy end point), varespladib/atorvastatin reduced mean LDL-C levels from baseline by 49.6% compared with 43.4% with placebo/atorvastatin (p = 0.002)."
c2 | LDL-C change used by the calculator | biomarker_change = -43.5 percent | {"biomarker": "LDL-C", "dose": "500 mg daily", "kind": "percent", "method": "not stated", "phase": "phase2", "placebo_adjusted": true, "timepoint": "24 weeks"} | source pmid:20863951 | quote: "At 24 weeks, respective reductions with varespladib and placebo were as follows: LDL-C 43.5% versus 37.6% (p < 0.05)"
c3 | sPLA2-IIA change used by the calculator | biomarker_change = -82.4 percent | {"biomarker": "sPLA2-IIA", "dose": "500 mg daily", "kind": "percent", "method": "not stated", "phase": "phase2", "placebo_adjusted": true, "timepoint": "8 weeks"} | source pmid:20863951 | quote: "Respective 8-week median reductions in sPLA(2)-IIA levels were 82.4% and 15.6% (p < 0.0001)"
c4 | sPLA2-IIA change used by the calculator | biomarker_change = -83.6 % | {"biomarker": "sPLA2-IIA", "dose": "500 mg daily", "kind": "percent", "method": "assay", "phase": "phase2", "placebo_adjusted": false, "timepoint": "8 weeks"} | source pmid:21989792 | quote: "varespladib methyl reduced median sPLA(2)-IIA levels by -83.6% in diabetic patients"
c5 | hsCRP change used by the calculator | biomarker_change = -75.0 percent | {"biomarker": "hsCRP", "dose": "500 mg daily", "kind": "percent", "method": "not stated", "phase": "phase2", "placebo_adjusted": true, "timepoint": "8 weeks"} | source pmid:20863951 | quote: "and hsCRP levels were lowered by 75.0% and 71.0% (p = 0.097)."
c6 | follow-up | primary_endpoint = Primary Objective of the Study [16 weeks]  | {"trial": "VISTA-16"} | source ctgov:NCT01130246@2012-03-09 | quote: "Primary outcome(s): Primary Objective of the Study [16 weeks]"

Write one query per claim.
response: {"checks": [{"claim": "c1", "table": "papers", "sql": "SELECT regexp_extract(r.abstractText, '([^.]*49\\\\.6%[^.]*)', 1) AS sentence FROM papers LATERAL VIEW explode(resultList.result) AS r WHERE r.pmid = '20863951' LIMIT 5"}, {"claim": "c2", "table": "papers", "sql": "SELECT regexp_extract(r.abstractText, '([^.]*43\\\\.5%[^.]*)', 1) AS sentence FROM papers LATERAL VIEW explode(resultList.result) AS r WHERE r.pmid = '20863951' LIMIT 5"}, {"claim": "c3", "table": "papers", "sql": "SELECT regexp_extract(r.abstractText, '([^.]*82\\\\.4%[^.]*)', 1) AS sentence FROM papers LATERAL VIEW explode(resultList.result) AS r WHERE r.pmid = '20863951' LIMIT 5"}, {"claim": "c4", "table": "papers", "sql": "SELECT regexp_extract(r.abstractText, '([^.]*83\\\\.6%[^.]*)', 1) AS sentence FROM papers LATERAL VIEW explode(resultList.result) AS r WHERE r.pmid = '21989792' LIMIT 5"}, {"claim": "c5", "table": "papers", "sql": "SELECT regexp_extract(r.abstractText, '([^.]*75\\\\.0%[^.]*)', 1) AS sentence FROM papers LATERAL VIEW explode(resultList.result) AS r WHERE r.pmid = '20863951' LIMIT 5"}, {"claim": "c6", "table": "registry", "sql": "SELECT o.measure, o.timeFrame FROM registry LATERAL VIEW explode(protocolSection.outcomesModule.primaryOutcomes) AS o WHERE protocolSection.identificationModule.nctId = 'NCT01130246' AND o.measure LIKE '%Primary Objective of the Study%' LIMIT 5"}]
